parts.words: A person who plays at work
parts.note: plays here means acts in stage plays as a job, not idles

explanation.walkthrough: 'plays at work' suggests someone slacking off, but an actor's work is performing in plays.
explanation.definitionFit: A thespian is an actor, named after Thespis, said to be the first Greek actor.

clue.text: Offend stranger possibly with some craft

indicators.note: possibly means the letters may be arranged another way

clue.text: Safeguards certain bonds

parts.note: certain means SURE
bonds are TIES

explanation.surface: Protections are offered on reliable financial bonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Sureties are guarantees or pledges given as security, protecting against default.

clue.text: "Standard" means processed cheese

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level

indicators.note: processed means worked over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ordinary product passed off as a processed cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Parmesan is a hard Italian cheese from the Parma region.

clue.text: Sparkling wine? Some prefer a still one

indicators.note: some of means only part of the following words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A drinker turns down sparkling wine in favour of a still one.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white from Piedmont in Italy.

clue.text: "Every arrow that flies feels the — of earth.". (Longfellow)

clue.text: Left one sailor mangling

clue.text: Chewing over "Spitting Image"

clue.text: Middle-of-the-road fashion to consider

clue.text: A shady character's misdemeanour?

getting into means the animals go inside the compass points

clue.text: Applause is of little account, right?

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether applause counts for little.

clue.text: Romance had to be different for Hector's wife

clue.text: Trendy woman and egghead are inseparable

clue.text: Date main changes — it's vital

clue.text: Notice a churchman's control
